……Let's not. I don't think I can win you in a debate.
There must be a far simpler, clearer way to settle this.

……I never thought of it that way.

m900531.──これで今回も一件落着、ですかね。: ──So, that wraps things up for this time, I suppose.

Ah, you may be right.

The facts are that Gungnir and Draupnir are here, with us.
m900531.あいつがお前たちの殉死を望んでいる根拠は？\n主人の死に際にも付き従えなかった使:
What proof do you have that he desired your martyrdom?
Servants who could not stay by their master's side even in death—
how can you be so certain my interpretation is wrong?
m900531.あとはぶん殴って躾けてやるだけだ！ 行け、王子！:
After that, all we have to do is beat some sense into him! Go, Prince!
--- scene: Divine Beast Fuginn/Munin Descends Extreme Rank ---
m900531.いいや、ぼくは完璧に理解している。\nあいつはな、人類に託したかったんだよ。\n:
No, I understand perfectly well.
He wanted to entrust it to humanity.
The power to stand against impossible adversity!
m900531.いえ、今回ばかりは私も素直に祝福していますよ。\nグングニル、ドラウプニル、そし:
No, I'm genuinely happy for you this time.
Gungnir, Draupnir, and now Fuginn and Munin──
m900531.うるさいな、無いものを勝手に感じるな。: Shut up. Don't project feelings that don't exist.
m900531.ええ、ではそういうことにしておきましょう。\nですが、雷神や主神様も喜んでいると:
I see, then let's leave it at that.

Seeing you work so hard and earnestly──
m900531.えっと、アスガルドの主神に仕えていた神獣……ですよね？: Um, they were the divine beasts who served the chief god of Asgard…… right?
m900531.これからたっぷりコキ使ってやるから覚悟しておけよ。: You better brace yourself, because I'm going to work you to the bone from now on.
m900531.そう、フギンムニンという強大な戦力をな！: Yes, a formidable force like Fuginn and Munin!
m900531.その鎧さえあればどんな脳筋だろうが、\n魔術的センス皆無のド素人だろうが、\n知: With that armor, even the biggest musclehead or the most talentless magic novice can wield a fraction of the God of Wisdom's power.

Besides, a human mind could never hope to control us.
Only Wardyn, the God of Wisdom, was capable of such a feat.
m900531.それぐらいしか取り柄がないものでね。\nバスティスとの話し合いは有益だったかい？:
It's about the only thing I'm good at.
Was your conversation with Bastis useful?
m900531.それともウォーディーンの解釈バトルでもするか？\nぼくには三日三晩だろうが付き合:
Or would you like to engage in a battle of interpretations?
I am prepared to keep this up for three days and three nights.
m900531.それはお前の勝手な解釈だ。願望と言っても良い。: That is merely your own interpretation. A wishful one, at that.
m900531.それは無理だ、今しがた魔力を使い果たしたからな。: That's impossible. I just used up all my magic.
m900531.それをみすみす死なせるなんてありえるか！？\nなのにあいつら……こっちの話を聞き:
How can we just let them die?!
But they…… they won't listen to a word we say!
m900531.だけど、鎧にしちまえば魔力を吸い尽くされることもない。\n必要な分だけ権能をちょ:
But now that they're armor, they won't drain your magic away.
You just need to siphon off a little of their authority when you need it.
m900531.ちなみにウォーディーンが我らを動かすため、\n一日に消費する魔力量がおおよそこれ:
By the way, this is roughly the amount of mana Wardyn consumes
in a single day to keep us in motion.
m900531.つまり、あいつは確固たる意思で『そう』したんだ。: In other words, he did it with a firm intention.
m900531.で、そいつらが目を覚ましたのがつい先日のことだ。: And they only woke up a few days ago.
m900531.どうしてウォーディーンはお前たちを遠ざけた？\nディアスのアスガルド侵攻直前に物:
Why did Wodin send you away?
He dispatched you to the material world right before Dias's invasion of Asgard,
and never called you back once the battle began.
m900531.なに、約束は違えんさ。フギンムニンは汝と共に在る。: What? We are not breaking our promise. Fuginn and Munin will remain by your side.
m900531.なんかそんなんおったような気もするのぅ。\nして、そのフギムニとやらがどうしたの:
I feel like I've heard of them before.
So, what's the problem with these Fugin and Munin of yours?
m900531.はあ？ なんだ急に、新手の嫌味か？: Hah? What's with the sudden new insult?
m900531.はいはい、堂々巡りね。では問おう、智の神の使徒よ。\nお前たちはなぜ己が物質界に:
Yes, yes, you're going in circles. Let me ask you, servants of the God of Wisdom.
Have you ever considered why you are in the material world?
m900531.はっはっはっは、ヌンの黒猫風情がほざくじゃないか。\nでもまあ助かったよ、おかげ:
Hahahaha. For a mere black cat of Nunn, you talk big.
But thanks to you, we managed to buy some time.
m900531.ふぅ、まったく手を焼かせやがって……。: Hmph, you really put up a fight...
m900531.ふむふむ……王国中の魔術師が一日で干物になりますね。: Mm-hmm…… Every mage in the kingdom would be reduced to a crisp in a day.
m900531.ま、たまにゃあ剣を置くのも悪かないだろ。: Well, it's not a bad idea to put the sword away for a change.
m900531.まあ、初めてにしちゃ上手くいったと思うぜ。: But I'd say it turned out pretty well for a first try.
m900531.まさか自分自身を鎧にしちゃうなんてねー。: Who would've thought they'd turn themselves into armor, though.
m900531.まさに『着るだけで誰でも一流魔術師！』ってやつだな。: It's the real deal: "Put it on, and you're a first-rate mage!"
m900531.まっっっったく楽しくにゃかったが？\nこいつら二羽とも性格が暗すぎるにゃ！\nア:
Not even a little, nya?
Both of them are way too gloomy, nya!
Is everyone in Asgard like that, nya?
m900531.めでたいことではないか、何が問題なのじゃ？: That sounds like a happy development. What's the issue?
m900531.やぁバスティス、神獣とのおしゃべりは楽しかったかい？: Hey, Bastis. Did you enjoy chatting with the divine beasts?
m900531.ゆえに我らに意義は無く、この世に留まる理由も無し。: Therefore, we have no purpose, and no reason to remain in this world.
m900531.よし、王子ちょいと装備してみな。: Alright, Prince, come give it a try.

Ikol, please keep your voice down.
I apologize for startling everyone.
There is something I must tell the Prince at once……
m900531.イコルか……よくもまあここまで小細工を弄すものだ。: So it's you, Ikol… You certainly know how to pull off these petty tricks.
m900531.イコルよ、まあそう言うな。\n我が王に対するお前の深い想い、\n中々に感じ入るも:
Ikol, don't be so hard on yourself.
Your deep affection for our King was quite moving.
m900531.デリカシーとかにゃーのか？: Do you have no sense of tact?
m900531.ハリンヘイムさんまで……\nお二人が揃ってお出でになるとは、\nどうやらただ事で:
Harinheim-san, too……
With the two of you here together,
this must be no small matter.
m900531.ハリンヘイムも、心配を掛けたな。: Harinheim, I'm sorry for worrying you.
m900531.フギンムニンはウォーディーンの使い魔、\n糸の切れた操り人形をイメージすればいい:
Fugin and Munin are Wodin's familiars.
Think of them as puppets whose strings have been cut.
The fact that they woke up on their own is a miracle in itself.
m900531.今は亡き我が王の御名においてフギン/ムニンが問う。: In the name of our late King, Fuginn and Munin ask:
m900531.今は詭弁と屁理屈でどうにか言いくるめているが、\nそれで誤魔化せる時間はそう長く:
We're managing to talk them out of it with sophistry and excuses,
but we can't keep that up for long.
In the end, there is no choice but to stop them by force.
m900531.価値はともかく、今や数少ないアスガルドの生き残り。\n私としてもフギンとムニンに:
Setting their value aside, they are now among the few survivors of Asgard.
Personally, I do not want Fugin and Munin to die.
m900531.前置きは省く、この中にフギンムニンを知っている者は？: Let's skip the pleasantries. Is there anyone here who knows what Fugin and Munin are?
m900531.思考を司るフギンと、記憶を司るムニン。\n日夜世界を飛び回りながら全ての出来事を:
Fugin, the god of thought, and Munin, the god of memory.
They fly across the world day and night, recording every event,
serving as the eyes and ears of the god of wisdom, Wodin──
m900531.我が唯一にして絶対の王は此処に無く──: Our one and only, absolute King is not here──
m900531.我が王はこの翼を人類へと託した。\nこれより我らが力は王国と共に在る。:
Our King entrusted these wings to humanity.
From now on, our power shall reside with the kingdom.
m900531.我らが眠っていた間のあらましは全て聞いた。\nだが、その上で我らの返答は変わらぬ:
We have heard everything that transpired while we slept.
However, our answer remains the same.
m900531.我らは使い魔だ、本来独立した存在ではない。\n主からの魔力供給なしに動くことはで:

m900531.攻め手を得意とするフギンと、守勢や搦手を担うムニン。\n相互に補完し合う彼らの連:
Fuginn excels in offense, while Munin handles defense and trickery.
Their complementary coordination will be a significant threat.
m900531.既に我が王は先に旅立たれてしまわれたのだ。\n今さら我らがその崇高なお考えを知る:
Our King has already departed.
We cannot possibly know the nature of his noble thoughts now.
m900531.早いな、流石は火と鉄の亜神。: Quick work. Truly befitting the sub-deity of fire and iron.
m900531.最悪、流れ込む情報量に耐えられず脳が破壊される。: In the worst case, the sheer volume of incoming information would shatter the brain.
m900531.案ずるな、そうならぬよう考えはある。: Do not worry. We have a plan to prevent that from happening.
m900531.構いませんよ、同じアスガルドの仲間ではありませんか。: It's nothing. We're all comrades of Asgard, aren't we?
m900531.死んだ主に殉じて後を追おうとしてるんだよ！\nフギンとムニンはウォーディーンの遺:
They're trying to follow their dead master into death!
Fugin and Munin are among Wodin's most valuable legacies,
rivaling even Gungnir and Draupnir!
m900531.汝その卑小なる人の身にて、我が器に足り得るか──！: Can your wretched, mortal body truly serve as our vessel—!
m900531.油断するなよ、あいつらは神獣である前に魔術師だ。\nそれも知恵の神から直々に教え:
Don't get cocky. Before they're divine beasts, they're mages.
And they're top-tier, having been trained directly by the God of Wisdom──
m900531.王子、といったか。: You are the Prince, I take it.
m900531.王子、此度の神獣フギンムニン戦もお疲れ様でした！: Prince, great work on the Fuginn and Munin battle!
m900531.王子殿下もついに魔術師になってしまいましたか……。: So, Your Highness has finally become a mage as well...
m900531.生きていたんだよ、この物質界でな。\nぼくはてっきりディアスのアスガルド侵攻で、:
They're alive. Right here in this material world.
I assumed they perished during Dias's invasion of Asgard, but──
m900531.直前に主神様の命で、アスガルドを離れていたんです。\nそしてそのまま帰る場所を失:
They had left Asgard on the chief god's orders just before the invasion.
As a result, they lost their home and were left behind.
m900531.確かに、あいつらの力を感じるな……。: Indeed, I can feel their power in it…
m900531.神獣の魂を鎧の形に加工しろなんてオーダー、\n最初はまじでふざけてやがんのかと思:
An order to process a divine beast's soul into the shape of armor…
At first, I seriously thought you were pulling my leg—
m900531.神獣フギンムニンを使役できるのはウォーディーンだけ。\n唯一にして絶対の主っての:
Only Wodin could command the divine beasts Fuginn and Munin.
The idea of them having a single, absolute master was meant literally.
m900531.腕の良い鍛冶師を用意しておいてくれ。\n王国もそれだけ亜神を引き入れているのだ、:
Prepare a skilled blacksmith for us.
The kingdom has brought in that many demigods, so
it must have some ties to one or two of the smith gods, right?
m900531.至急、部隊の編成に取り掛かりましょう。\n敵はアスガルドの神獣『フギンムニン』で:
Let's get to work on forming the unit immediately.
The enemy is the divine beast of Asgard, "Fuginn and Munin."
They likely possess the "Might of the Gods" as well.
m900531.良かったですね、イコル。\n主神様の──いえ、お義兄さんの形見が揃って。:
I'm glad, Ikol.
You've gathered all the keepsakes of the All-Father... no, your brother-in-law.
m900531.装備したいときは称号を【双鴉を従えし者】だ、覚えとけよ。: When you want to equip it, use the title "One Who Commands the Twin Ravens." Remember that.

m920074.むしろ、このタイミングを見計らって\n攻めてきているのかもしれませんね。: Perhaps they're timing their assault deliberately.

Once everyone has taken the medicine, we'll begin dispersing it across this land.

m920074.アリサさんの言うとおりですね。\nこの状態で魔物に襲われては危険なのは\n明白…: As Alissa says. Being ambushed by monsters in this condition would be disastrous. Then, Prince, we'll head back—

m920074.エリアス殿の言うとおりです。\nさ、王子軍の皆さん。\n進軍の準備をお願い致しま: Exactly as Lord Elias says. Now, troops of the Prince, prepare to advance.

m920074.デーモンの掃滅を確認。\n各隊、目立った死傷者もありません。\nまずまずの勝利と: Demon sweep confirmed. No significant casualties in any unit. I'd say it's a decent victory.
m920074.ビフロンスが有する同族の士気を高揚させる\n能力こそが、我ら鬼刃衆にとっては、\: We realized that Bifrons's ability to boost the morale of his kind is the perfect power for us, the Oni Blade Squad!
m920074.フフフ……人間の地で生まれた病に\nエルフ族が倒れるとは実に滑稽だな。: Heh heh… How amusing that the elves are falling to a disease born of human lands.

m920074.ブブッ……たかが羽虫と油断しおって……。: Bub… underestimating it as just a winged insect…

m920074.ブブッ……まさかあの暴走したトロルを倒すとは、\n人間の力はやはり侮れないな……: Bub… I never thought we'd defeat that rampaging troll. Human strength really shouldn't be underestimated… Bub.
m920074.ブブッ……ブッ、ブブッ……ばかな……。\nベルゼビュート様が負ける、だと……？\: …Boo… Boo, boo… This is ridiculous… Belzebuth losing…? No, what's even stranger…
m920074.ブブッ……ベルゼビュート様が復活した今、\nもはや貴様らなど取るに足らん……。: …Now that Belzebuth has returned, you lot are nothing…
m920074.ブブッ……仲間とはぐれてしまったようだな……。\n一体ここはどこなのだ？: Bub… looks like I've gotten separated from my comrades… Where on earth am I?
m920074.ブブッ……厄介な奴らが手を組んだな。\nしかし、治療薬を渡すとは計算外だったな。: Brr… troublesome allies have teamed up. Still, giving them the cure wasn't in the plan. That should be a valuable thing…
m920074.ブブッ……愚かなる人間たちよ。\nせいぜい束の間の勝利に喜んでいるがいい。: Bub… foolish humans. Enjoy your fleeting victory while it lasts.
m920074.ブブッ……我々は食べ物ではない！\n生きている者ならば何でも食べようとするとは…: Bub… we're not food! To think you'd eat anything living… That's enough. We'll go find another monster to use. Bub.
m920074.ブブッ……随分と遅かったな、人間共よ。\n既に貴様の仲間たちにはしっかりと\n我: …Boo… You humans are really late. We've already let your comrades settle the score… Boo.
m920074.ブブッ……！ これはこれで良いな。\nこの状態のトロルを人間へと差し向ければ\n: Bub…! This works too. Sending a troll in this condition to humans would be interesting… Bub.
m920074.ヘッ、このモーティマ様が\nたかだか病気ごときにやられるわけねぇだろ！: Hah, this Mortimer won't be felled by a mere sickness!

m920074.ベルゼビュート様はもう間もなく完全体になるのだ。\nその時が来れば、お前たちなど: Lord Belzebuth will soon reach his true form. When that happens, you'll be reduced to dust in an instant… Bub.

Lady Leona!

m920074.奴の自己修復能力と我々が持つ病原菌が\nせめぎあうことで精神異常が生じ、\n凶暴: So its self-repair ability and our pathogen clash, causing mental instability and making it go berserk… Bub!

m920074.帝国の方達は皆、\nとりあえず立てるまでに回復できたようですね。\nアリサさん達: It looks like everyone in the Empire managed to recover enough to stand up for now. Thanks to Alissa and the others for their swift response.

m920074.王子……く、来るな……このままでは、\n全滅は免れない……ベルゼビュートが、\n: Prince… D-Don't come… If we keep going like this, we'll be wiped out… Belzebuth has fully revived… Ugh…

m920074.王子、このままエリアスさん達と協力し、\nベルゼビュートのもとへと向かいましょう: Prince, let's keep cooperating with Elias and the others and head straight for Belzebuth!
m920074.王子、この地にて謎の疫病が蔓延しているという\n報告を受けて調査に来ましたが、\: Prince, we received reports of a mysterious plague spreading in this land, so we came to investigate, but we still haven't figured out the cause…

m920074.王子、我が軍への助力、及び救護、感謝する。\nだがこれ以上、貴国に恥を晒すわけに: Prince, we appreciate your aid to our forces and the medical support. But we can't keep bringing shame upon your kingdom. …All troops, withdraw immediately!
m920074.王子軍の皆さん……逃げて下さい……。\nそして……帝国に……皇帝に、この事を……: Everyone in the Prince's army… Run away… And… tell the Empire… tell the Emperor… about this…
m920074.疫病が蔓延しているときに攻めてくるなんて\nタイミングわるすぎるぜ……！: Attacking while a plague is raging—what terrible timing…
m920074.疫病感染者の治療はどうなっている？: What's the status of treating the infected?

m920074.相変わらずですね、帝国は……。: The Empire never changes, does it…

m920074.私たちも行きます！\nこの目でちゃんとベルゼビュートの脅威が\n取り除かれたこと: We'll go too! We have to see with our own eyes that Belzebuth's threat has truly been eliminated.

m920081.ほー……。確かに結構人数がいるな。\nもう悪さしないように一網打尽にしてやるぜ！: Huh… Yeah, there are quite a few of them. I'll wipe them out in one fell swoop so they can't cause any more trouble!
m920081.ほ～さすが武器商人、羽振りが良いじゃねぇか。\nだが、これっぽっちじゃぜんぜん足:
Hoo, as expected of a weapons dealer, you're well-heeled.
But this pitiful amount is nowhere near enough.
Hey, gorgeous—hand over your sister too.
m920081.まさか、魔物の手に渡ってしまったなんて……。\n魔物達にとっては強大な力を得られ: I never imagined they'd end up in monster hands. If the monsters can gain such power, losing their own lives is a trivial matter to them.
m920081.まだ売人は近くにいるはずです。\n王子、引き続き先ほどの売人を探しましょう！: The dealer should still be nearby. Prince, let's keep looking for that seller we just encountered!
m920081.もしかして、この武器ですか？\nさっきゴブリンが逃げる時に落として\nいったよう: Could it be this weapon? The goblin dropped it when they fled earlier.
m920081.アリサちゃん……リュリュちゃん、\n何ていいコ達なの！？ あたし、感動しちゃった: Alissa-chan… Ryuryu-chan, what wonderful kids you are! I'm actually moved!
m920081.アリサちゃんったら照れちゃって可愛いんだから。\nお祭りなんだから、気にしない気:
Alissa-chan, you're so cute when you get embarrassed.
It's a festival, so don't worry about it!
Come on, hurry and change!
m920081.アンタ等が探してる武器の売人は、\nもう少しで俺達のところにまた取引しにくるぜ。:
The vendor you're after will be coming back to us soon for another deal.
Just talk to him when he shows up.
m920081.エイミーさん、盗まれた「呪いの武器」の在処は\nすでに分かっているのでしょうか？: Amy-san, do we already know where the stolen cursed weapon is?
m920081.オークさん、お願いですからその武器を返して下さい。\nその武器は呪われています！:
Orc, please give that weapon back.
It's cursed!
We'll even buy it from you for a high price!
m920081.ククク……斬ル……全テ、斬ッテヤル……。: Heh heh… I'll cut… I'll slice them all…
m920081.サスガ王子、相変ワラズ強いノデアル。\nしかしココまでハ、ワタクシモ想定内デアル: As expected, Prince, you're always incredibly strong. But even I had anticipated this far. Goblin soldiers, equip these weapons at once.
m920081.サラサさん、この星形の飾りはどこがいいでしょうか？: Sarasa-san, where should I put this star-shaped ornament?
m920081.セシリーさん！ ありがとうございます！\nこれ以上、武器が人を不幸にするのを見た: Cecily!  Thank you!  I won't stand by while weapons bring more misery.  Prince, let's move quickly!
m920081.ナ、ナンダト！ ソンナ副作用ガ！？\nイワク付キの品トハ、想定外デアル……。\n: W-what!? Such side effects!? I thought it was a harmless item… but the killing power is still off the charts!
m920081.ハァ、クイーン様から賜った予算ギリギリで\n仕入レタノニ……。ワタクシ、ショック: Ha… I stretched the Queen's budget to the limit to procure it… I'm shocked… How should I explain this?
m920081.ハカセ タイヘン！\nコレ、タイリョク ヘル！: Professor, this is terrible! It's a lethal hell!
m920081.フン……人間共よ、知らぬようだから教えてやる。\n魔界マーケットに品物を流してい: Hmph… Humans, you're clueless, so let me teach you. The ones funneling goods into the Demon-Realm Market are none other than the surface-world humans.
m920081.マ、敗ケハシタガ、一定の収穫はアッタノデアル。\nもっとアノ武器ヲ仕入れテ次こそ: We were defeated, but we did manage to snag some loot. Next time we'll stock up on those weapons for sure… Prince, remember this!
m920081.メリークリスマース！\nってことで、年に一度のお祭りに向けて準備を\nしてるわけ: Merry Christmas! With that, we're prepping for the once-a-year festival—hope everyone's having fun!
m920081.ワタクシ、何も見テないノデアル。\n敵デアル人間ニ情報は売らないノデアル！: I didn't see anything. I won't sell information to enemy humans!
m920081.今こそ、この武器の切れ味を試させてもらうぞ！: Now's the time to put this weapon's edge to the test!
m920081.今の彼らはごく少数の売人が取引の実働部隊として\n活動していて、組織の全貌はほと: These days only a handful of dealers act as the active trading arm, and we know almost nothing about the organization's full scope.
m920081.仕方ない、高値で売れるのは分かってるけど、\nこの重たい武器は置いていくしかない:
Fine, I know I could sell it for a high price, but
I've got no choice but to leave this heavy weapon behind.
…Damn, what a loss.
m920081.何はともあれ、\n「呪いの武器」を取り戻せて良かったです。: Anyway, I'm glad we got the “cursed weapon” back.
m920081.何を言っているのだ、あの小娘は……？\nこれは我々がきちんと金を払って買ったもの: What is this little girl saying...? We paid proper money for this. If you have a complaint, take it up with the seller.
m920081.俺達売人は、お互い何かあった時の為に、\n取引の場所をいくつか予め決めてるからな: We dealers set up a few preset meeting spots for when something goes down between us.
m920081.先ほどゴブリンから\nいくつか取り返す事は出来ましたが、\n盗まれたのは、あれで: I managed to recover a few from the goblins earlier, but that's not all that was taken.
m920081.分かりました。\nそれでは落ち着いて話せる場所へ移動しましょう。: Understood. Then let's move to a place where we can talk calmly.
m920081.初めまして、王子。\n私は武器を専門に取り扱っている商人で、\n名前はエイミーと: Nice to meet you, Prince. I'm a merchant who deals in weapons—my name's Amy.
m920081.呪いはその殆どが禁忌の古代魔術や\n魔物の断末魔の悪あがきによる強固なもの……。: Most of these curses are forged from forbidden ancient magic or the desperate dying throes of monsters… they aren't easily dispelled.
m920081.売人さん、いくらお金の為とはいえ、\n魔物にあんな危険な武器を売るなんて、\n絶: Merchant, even if it's for money, selling such a dangerous weapon to monsters is absolutely unforgivable!?
m920081.大口の取引……！？\nきっと「呪いの武器」を今まで以上に危険な相手へ\n売るつも: A huge deal…!? You're planning to sell the “cursed weapon” to an even more dangerous buyer, aren't you!?
m920081.実は、ここ東方の国にて妖刀を手にした侍たちが\n次々と自我を失うという異事が起き: Actually, here in the Eastern Kingdom, samurai who wield the cursed blade have been losing their minds one after another!
m920081.実は色々と込み入った話でして……。\n私の話を聞いて頂けないでしょうか？: Actually it's a rather tangled story… Could you hear me out?
m920081.年に一度のお祭りを、こんなことで台無しにされて\nたまるもんですか！ \n皆さん: Ruining the once-a-year festival like this is unforgivable! Everyone, get ready to fight!
m920081.思い当たる売人の存在を知っています……。\n少し前に壊滅した悪漢を束ねる組織の残: I know of a suspect dealer… It's a remnant of the organization that led the band of thugs we recently wiped out, rumored to be trading stolen goods through its own channels.
m920081.悪漢を束ねる組織……もしかして、闇ギルドのことか？\nそれなら、１年程前に確かに: An organization that gathers thugs… could it be the Dark Guild? If so, we did crush them about a year ago… I never imagined any remnants survived.
m920081.手がかりは他にないですし、仕方ありません。\nおそらく、ゴブリンはこの辺りにいる: We have no other leads, so it can't be helped. The goblins should be around here. I think they'll show up once they know the Prince is here.
m920081.早速本題なのですが、\n実は、さっきゴブリンが落としていった武器は\n「呪いの武: Getting straight to the point, the weapon that goblin dropped earlier is a cursed weapon.
m920081.早速現れましたね！\n王子、戦いの準備をお願い致します！: They're showing up right away! Prince, please get ready for battle!
m920081.武器商人として、これ以上、「呪いの武器」の被害を\n増やすわけにはいかないと思い: As a weapons merchant, I can't stand by and let more people suffer, so I've decided to start collecting cursed weapons.
m920081.気に病むことはありません！\nこの武器を東方の国に持ち込んだ売人が\nいけないの: Don't worry about it!  The dealer who brought this weapon into the Eastern Kingdom is to blame.
m920081.猫耳フード？ あぁ、セブンの事か。\nあいつなら、多分、この近くの路地裏で\n大: Cat-ear hood? Oh, you mean Seven. He's probably in an alley nearby, making the big deal.
m920081.王子、ありがとうございます！\nどうにか「呪いの武器」を取り戻すことができました: Prince, thank you! We managed to recover the cursed weapon!
m920081.王子、お願いです。\nどうか残りの「呪いの武器」を探すのを\n手伝って頂けないで: Prince, I'm begging you—could you help me find the remaining cursed weapons?
m920081.王子、ご覧下さい！ イロハさんがいます！\n助けを求める書状をもとに東方の国まで: Prince, look! Iroha's here! She came all the way from the Eastern Kingdom after receiving a plea for help, and… thank goodness, she seems to be alright.
m920081.王子、ゴブリン出現の報告があったのは\nこのあたりです。: Prince, we received reports of goblin activity around here.
m920081.王子、マーマンは海辺にいるはずです。\nすぐに向かいましょう！: Prince, the mermen should be at the shoreline. Let's head there right away!
m920081.王子、其方との再戦を楽しみにしている。\n今日のオレは心なしか本調子を出せなかっ:
Prince, I look forward to our next battle.
I didn't quite hit my stride today.
…Well then, farewell!
m920081.王子メ……今度こそハ負けないノデアル。\nクイーン様から賜ッタ予算スベテを、\n: Prince… this time I won't lose. I'll pour the Queen's entire budget into that weapon! Prepare yourself!
m920081.生命力を奪う「呪いの武器」なんて、\n誰も欲しがらないし、\n売り物にはならない: No one wants a weapon that steals life, and they shouldn't be sellable at all…
m920081.相応しき者に武器が渡らなければ、真価は示されない……。\n魔界マーケットの武器商: If a weapon doesn't go to someone worthy, its true value will never be shown… The merchants of the Demon-Realm Market don't understand that!
m920081.私が油断したばっかりに、ごめんなさい……。\nですが、当初の目的である武器回収は: I'm sorry for letting my guard down… But we still accomplished our original goal of retrieving the weapon, so it's a happy ending!
m920081.私はこれまで、沢山の冒険者や\n次代の勇者と名乗る者達が、\n「呪いの武器」の餌: I've watched countless adventurers and those who call themselves the next heroes fall prey to cursed weapons.
m920081.私は武器専門の商人です。\n貴方達が持っている武器に興味があるのですが、\n一体:
I'm a weapons merchant.
I'm interested in the arms you have,
so who did you buy them from?
m920081.簡単なことだ。貴様がその武器を使い、\n人間を斬ればいいだけのことだ。: Simple. You use that weapon and cut down a human.
m920081.見つけましたよ、マーマン！\nあなた達が魔界マーケットで購入した武器は盗品です！: I've found you, mermen! The weapon you bought at the Demon Realm Market is stolen! Return it to me, its rightful owner, at once!
m920081.貴様の様な拝金の輩の許ではなく、\n我らの様な戦士と共にありたいとな。:
Not by money-hungry scum like you,
but by warriors like us.
m920081.違うよ、ナイン。\nこれから大口の取引なんだ。\n他のブツは置いていこうと思って: No, Nine. I'm here for a big deal. I'm planning to leave the rest of the goods behind.
m920081.金銭の問題と捉えているとは……話しにならんな。\n我らはこの武器が今必要だから買: You treat this as merely a money issue… I won't argue with you. We bought this weapon because we need it right now. No matter how much you pile on, we have no intention of selling it at all!
m920081.闇ギルドの事をご存知だったのですね。\n壊滅した時期からしても、\nそのギルドで: You were aware of the Dark Guild. Given when they were destroyed, it must be that guild.
m920081.駄目だ、完全に自我を失っている！\nあの侍、刀を手にした途端に様子がおかしくなっ: No good, they've completely lost their sense of self! That samurai went crazy the moment he grabbed the sword—so the rumors about the cursed blade were true after all…
m920081.魔界への武器の供給については、商人仲間の間でもチラ\nホラ噂を聞いていたので、危: I'd heard rumors, even among my merchant friends, about weapon shipments to the demon realm, so I was wary… The Merman's words have given me confirmation.
m920081.魔界マーケット……？\nだとすると、他の魔物達の手にも渡っているって事か。\nゴ: The Demon Realm Market…? Then that means other monsters could have gotten their hands on it too. Goblin, didn't you see anyone else buying it?
m920081.魔界マーケットの店主め、何が\n「これで噂の王子も一刀両断！」だ。\nとんだなま: That Demon-Realm Market shopkeeper—what a joke, “Now even the famed Prince will be cut down in one swing!” What a ridiculous thing they've handed us…
m920081.魔界マーケットの店主もオススメ。\n「これで噂の王子も一刀両断！」のウタイ文句に: Even the demon-world market shopkeeper recommends it. “With this, even the famed Prince will be sliced in two!”—that ridiculous slogan made me buy it on the spot…
m920081.（ああっ！ 売人さんが行ってしまいます！\n王子、踏み込みましょう！）: (Ah! The dealer's leaving! Prince, let's move in!)
m920081.（あの売人さん、セブンさんっていう名前なのですね。\nもう一人はナイン……。\n: (So that's the dealer called Seven… The other one is Nine… This brings us closer to the core of the organization…!)
m920081.（あれは名前ではなくコードネームだよ、アンナさん。\n彼らは本名を仲間にも明かさ: (That's not a real name, Anna. It's a codename. They never reveal their real names to anyone.)
m920081.（ア、アレハ……ゴールド！）\nアッ！ タッタ今思イ出シタノデアル！\nマーマン: (Ah, gold!) Ah! I just remembered! The mermen bought up the rest.
m920081.（売人のアジトはここだ王子。\nそこそこ数がいるから注意した方が良い）: (This is the dealer's hideout, Prince. There are quite a few of them, so we should be careful.)

m920190.……お呼びですとも。\nさあ、お客様のお帰りです。\n出口に案内していただきたい:
...I did.
Now, it's time for my guests to leave.
Please show us to the exit.
m920190.……なにか、気味が悪いですね。\nのぼせる前に早く上がりましょう。:
……Something feels off.
Let's get out before we get too hot.
m920190.……まさか、毒など入っておりませんよ。: ...There's no poison in it, I assure you.
m920190.……問題は無事に下山できるかどうか。: ……The real question is whether we can make it down safely.
m920190.……顔を殴れば、さすがに痛いはず。: ...Punching the face would definitely hurt, I imagine.
m920190.──そうして、気づけば下山していたんです。: ──And before we knew it, we'd already made it down the mountain.
m920190.ああ、それだけお疲れだったようですね。\nですが、湯船での睡眠は危険なのでご注意:
Ah, so you must have been exhausted.
Just be careful, though. Sleeping in the bath can be dangerous.
m920190.あえて動乱の中に身を投じるか。\n見たい夢を見せるはずの迷い家の湯で、\n悪夢を:
To willingly throw yourselves into chaos...
The bath of the House of Lost Souls was meant to show you the dreams you wished to see,
yet you chose to see nightmares. You are a different breed.
m920190.いいい、いきなりどこから出てきたのよこいつら！？: Wha- where did these guys come from all of a sudden?!
m920190.いいえ、それでは巨人に小石を投げるようなもの。\n膨大な体力を誇る迷い家には効果: No, that would be like throwing pebbles at a giant. The House of Lost Souls has immense vitality, so such attacks would have little effect.
m920190.いいんですか！？ いっただっきま──: You're sure?! I'm gonna dig in──
m920190.うへぇ、まさか……野宿？: Oh no…… Are we camping out?
m920190.ええ、下手に動けば遭難もありえます。\nはぐれないよう全員で慎重に動きましょう。:
Yes, moving carelessly could lead to an accident.
Let's all move cautiously so we don't get separated.
m920190.ええ。アカネさんの言う通りです。\n今は脱出を最優先に──って、あれ？:
Agreed. You're right, Akane.
Our top priority right now is to escape──Wait, what's that?
m920190.おお、お上がりになられましたか。\nあんまり遅いので心配しましたよ。:
Oh, you're here at last.
I was worried when you took so long.
m920190.おそらく他のお鍋と三味線も同じでしょう。\n待っていれば痺れを切らして襲ってくる:
The other hot pots and shamisens are likely the same.
If we wait, they'll grow impatient and attack.
Prince, please be careful not to touch them carelessly!
m920190.おっと、刀を収めてください。\n決して怪しい者ではありません。:
Oh, put that blade away.
I'm no one suspicious.
m920190.おっと笑顔で誤魔化されちゃった。\nまあ？ 私としては？ 王子様との混浴に、\n:
Oh, you're hiding behind that smile.
But, you know? I'm more curious about
the ladies who aren't fazed by a bath with the Prince~♪
m920190.おまけに温泉付きですから、\nちょっとした旅行気分ですね♪:
And it comes with a hot spring, too.
It's giving me a bit of a vacation feel♪
m920190.お前たちに死相でも見えたのかもしれぬな。\n故に庇護せんと、尊大かつ傲慢に考えら:
Perhaps it saw a deathly aura on you.
So, in its grandiose and arrogant way, it decided to protect you.
m920190.お鍋と三味線の妖怪……いえ、付喪神ですか。\nおや、退治を依頼された妖怪に似てい:
A hot pot and a shamisen yokai... no, tsukumogami, I suppose.
My, they resemble the yokai we were hired to defeat.
m920190.お鍋のお汁が跳ねてあっぢいですね！？: The hot pot broth splashed everywhere! It's scalding!
m920190.お風呂上がったら宴会って言ってた。: We said we'd have a party after the bath.
m920190.くっ、宿の主人を見失いましたか……。: Curses, we lost sight of the Innkeeper...
m920190.こ、これだけの量のお料理をお一人で……？: A-Are you really going to eat all of that by yourself...?
m920190.ここからは攻守逆転、ということですか。: So the tables have turned, I see.
m920190.この方は罪なき民が死に逝く姿を忌み嫌う。\n我々にとっては間違いなく庇護者だった:
This being abhors the sight of innocent people dying.
To us, it was undoubtedly a protector.
m920190.この濃霧ではこれ以上の捜索は危険です。\n今日のところは諦めて下山するべきですね:
Searching any further in this dense fog would be dangerous.
We should give up for today and head down the mountain.
m920190.これだけの美女たちを侍らせて、\n王子様は一体どんな気分なのかな？:
With all these beauties attending you,
what must it feel like, Prince?
m920190.ご馳走ですか！？ お鍋ですね！？: A feast?! And it's a hot pot?!
m920190.さあ、おいでませ。我が主よ。: Now then, come in. My master.
m920190.さあ？ 大方住人が少なくなって、\n迷い家様も寂しかったのではないか？:
Who knows? Perhaps the number of residents had dwindled,
and the House of Lost Souls was simply lonely.
m920190.ささやかではありますが、\n宴会の準備が整っております。\n皆様どうぞお席にお着:
It's a modest spread, but
the banquet is ready.
Please, take your seats.
m920190.さすがにケーキはないんじゃ……。: I'm afraid there's no cake to be found...
m920190.すみません、湯船で寝てしまいまして。: I'm sorry. I must have fallen asleep in the bath.
m920190.そうしたいのは山々なのですが、\n時間を掛け過ぎてしまったようですね。\n今から:
I'd like to do that, but
it looks like we've wasted too much time.
It's too late to descend now.
m920190.そうだそうだー！ 早くここから出せー！: Yeah, yeah! Get us out of here already!
m920190.そうでしたか。あれは、夢だったのですね。\n確かに、風神と雷神が生きているはずが:
I see. So that was a dream.
Of course, the Wind God and Thunder God can't be alive.
m920190.そう言われると自信が揺らいできます……。: Hearing you say that shakes my confidence...
m920190.それ、衝撃に備えよ。\n迷い家様が拗ねておられる。\nお帰りはあちらだお客様。:
Brace yourselves for the shock.
The House of Lost Souls is sulking.
This way, please, guests.
m920190.であれば、手当たり次第に切り刻めば、\n痛手を与えられるということでしょうか。: In that case, if we just cut everything in sight, we can inflict serious damage, right?
m920190.ですが、仕方ありませんよ。\nこれほどまでに霧が濃くなるなんて、\n誰にも予想で:
But there's nothing we can do about it.
No one could have predicted the fog would grow this thick.
m920190.では、私たちをここに誘導したのは……。: Then, the reason it lured us here was...
m920190.どうしました？ 一口で構いませんよ。\nそれとも何か、食べられない理由でも？:
Is something wrong? A single bite will do.
Or is there some reason you can't eat?
m920190.なっ……風神、そして雷神！？\nそんな、彼らがどうしてここに！？:

I even bought some new snacks at the shop.
Let's just ditch everything for today.
m920228.購買部──ですが、まさかミネットさんに限って。: The general store... but I can't imagine Minette being involved.
m920228.遊戯部、というのは表の顔だな。\nその実態は鬼刃姫同好会の本部にして、\n不良学:
The "Gaming Club" is just a front.
In reality, it serves as the headquarters for the Oni Blade Princess Society
and a hangout for delinquent students.
m920228.過剰な開拓は確かに環境破壊に繋がるが、\n上手く自然と付き合う方法を見つけられた:
Excessive development certainly leads to environmental damage,
but if we can find a way to coexist with nature,
people and beasts can support one another and thrive.
m920228.道理で路地裏の奥の奥にあると思ったぜ！: No wonder it's tucked away at the back of a back alley!
m920228.違うぞメアリ、私たちは何も見ていない。\nなのにホムラが急に喧嘩を売ってきたんだ:
That's not it, Mary. We didn't see anything.
Homura is the one who suddenly started looking for a fight.
m920228.違うとまでは言いませんが、学園の想定からは逸れるかと。: I won't say you're wrong, but it's a bit outside the academy's usual scope.
m920228.部室の中を見せてもらっても？: May I take a look inside the club room?
m920228.開けろッ！ 風紀委員会だッ！: Open up! This is the Student Conduct Committee!
m920228.青春……そ、そうなのかな……？: School days… I, I suppose so…?
m920228.食事に戻りましょう、料理が冷めてしまいますわ。: Let's get back to our food. It's getting cold.
m920228.駄目に決まっているでしょう、教育に悪影響です！\nミネットさん、その人から離れて:
That is absolutely unacceptable; it's a bad influence on her education!
Minette-san, stay away from that person and come over here quickly──
m920228.魔物復活以前に建てられた軍学校だそうだよ。\n建物の老朽化でいつしか使われなくな:
I heard it was a military academy built before the monsters revived.
It fell into disuse as the building deteriorated.
m920228.黙れ！ 人間に下げる頭などない！: Shut up! I will never bow my head to humans!
m920228.（──物音？ メアリ、少し静かに）: (──A noise? Mary, could you be a little quieter?)
m920228.（あれは確か、ボーパルバニーだったか？\n世界樹の魔獣がどうしてこんなところに…:
(Is that a Bopal Bunny?
Why is a World Tree beast here…?)
m920228.（いつも綺麗な解決策があるわけではない。\n領主として選択を強いられる日がきっと:
(There isn't always a clean solution.
As a lord, there will surely come a day when I am forced to make a choice.)
m920228.（このお店で合っているはずなんですけど……）: (This should be the right place, but……)
m920228.（そのとき私は、\n自分に胸を張れる決断ができるでしょうか──）:
(When that day comes,
will I be able to make a decision I can stand behind──)
m920228.（それに、学生食堂という制度が素晴らしい。\n美味しいご飯を安価で提供してくれる:
(Besides, the student cafeteria system is wonderful.
Without the cafeteria serving delicious meals at low prices,
I wouldn't be able to survive my academy life, to put it mildly.)
m920228.（だが、今は傭兵稼業にも頭脳が必要な時代だ。\n家族のためを思えば、弱音は吐いて:
(But these are times when even mercenaries need brains.
If I want to provide for my family, I can't afford to complain.)
m920228.（ふぅ、今日も午前の授業を乗り切れたな。\nやはり学のない私には、学園の授業は難:
(Phew, I made it through the morning classes again.
No wonder the academy curriculum is so tough for someone with my limited education.)
m920228.（ふむ、分かってはいたがここに食材はなさそうだな）: (Hmm, I suspected as much. There doesn't seem to be any ingredients here.)
m920228.（まだまだ、学園で学ぶことは多そうですね♪）: (I still have so much to learn at the academy♪)
m920228.（ナシートさんの受けている授業、偏ってません？）: (Doesn't Nasheet's curriculum seem a bit skewed?)
m920228.（今の私は未熟もいいところですが、\n私の周りには殿下をはじめ尊敬できる方がたく:
(I may be quite inexperienced right now,
but I am surrounded by many people I look up to,
starting with Your Highness.)
m920228.（周囲を警戒する様子……。\nそれにあの手に持った大量の野菜は、\n学園に卸され:
(She's keeping watch…
And that massive pile of vegetables in her hand
are the same varieties supplied to the academy.)
m920228.（学園には秘密でボーパルバニーを飼っているのか。\n経緯はさておき、野菜の出処は:
(So the academy keeps Bopal Bunnies as a secret.
Setting the circumstances aside, I do want to know where those vegetables came from──)
m920228.（実家への仕送りの額を増やしても、\n十分に腹を満たせる楽園のような場所だ。\n:
(Even with the extra money I send home,
it's a paradise where I can fill my belly comfortably.
Now then, today's daily set menu is──)
m920228.（当然だ。しかし、彼女はここで何を……）: (Of course. But what is she doing here…?)
m920228.（彼女は、元闇ギルドの金庫番……！）: (She used to be the vault keeper for a dark guild...)
m920228.（心配で思わずついてきてしまいましたけど……）: (I couldn't help but follow out of worry...)
m920228.（思っていた以上にちゃんとしてます！）: (He's much more put-together than I expected!)
m920228.（教師や級友たち、周囲には優秀な人材ばかり。\n戦場しか知らぬ私には場違いに感じ:
(The teachers and my classmates are all brilliant people.
Sometimes it feels out of place for someone who only knows the battlefield.)
m920228.（私基準でもう三人前は食べてるのに……）: (Even by my standards, he's eaten at least three people's worth……)
m920228.（闇の組織との戦闘からそのまま食事を……！？\n同じ王国でも翠花の都と王都でここ:
(To go from fighting a dark organization straight to dinner……!?
Even within the same kingdom, the Emerald Capital and the Royal Capital couldn't be more different……)
m920228.（魔王との戦い、天界との戦いが終わり、\n世界共通の脅威がなくなったこれからの世:
(Now that the wars against the Demon King and the Celestial Realm are over,
and the world is free from a common threat,
there will surely be more situations that cannot be judged by good or evil.)

m930022.あいつの目的は力と恐怖による国家支配。\n根っからの俗物だが、その実力は本物だ。: His aim is to dominate the country through power and fear. He's a born materialist, but his strength is real.
m930022.ええ、私の師匠の師匠、そのまた師匠。\n全陰陽師の頂点にいらっしゃった方です。: Yes, my master's master—actually, the master of masters. The very pinnacle of all onmyoji.
m930022.この陰陽頭セイメイ、一生の不覚さ。\n内部の妖魔たちを根こそぎ祓い尽くして、\n: This Head Onmyoji Seimei—what a blunder. I had to purge every demon inside, and I only just managed to get out.
m930022.そうですよ、私たちがどれだけ心配したと──: That's right—we've been so worried about you—
m930022.そして西の京を中心に公家も武家も取り込み、\n急速に勢力を拡大させているドウマン: And Douman's Onmyoji Academy, which is pulling in both court nobles and samurai around the western capital, rapidly expanding its power.
m930022.その件については私も申し訳なく思っている。\nが、: I feel the same way, sorry about that. But,
m930022.その通り、流れの陰陽師が今や朝廷の左大臣だ。: Exactly. The onmyoji of the Flow is now the Left Minister of the Court.
m930022.だが、今は私の苦労話は置いておこう。\n正直なところ、我々にはまったく時間がない: Anyway, let's set my hardships aside. Frankly, we've got no time. What matters is the culprit who threw me into the Demon Gate—
m930022.ちなみに、この話を聞いた全員に拒否権はない。: By the way, anyone who's heard this has no right to refuse.
m930022.つまり、前陰陽頭ってことだよね。\n魔物復活後に姿を消した最強の陰陽師。\nそれ: So you're the former Head Onmyoji, right? The strongest onmyoji who vanished after the monsters resurfaced. Where have you been hiding all this time?
m930022.ふふ……久しぶりに曾孫弟子に会えて嬉しいよ、ミコト。: Heh… It's been a while since I've seen my great-grand-disciple, Mikoto. Glad to have you back.
m930022.もし君が死ねば、この国は群雄割拠の時代に逆戻り。\n東の都のシズカちゃんと、西の: If you die, this nation will slip back into an era of warring factions—Shizuka from the Eastern capital and Douman from the Western capital will spark a great war. From then on, a hundred years of peace is sure to be out of reach.
m930022.やあやあ諸君、よくぞ集まってくれた。\nまずは自己紹介から始めさせてもらおう。: Hey there, everyone—thanks for gathering. Let's start with introductions.
m930022.各地に点在するカラスマル卿率いる親政派。: The pro-imperial faction led by Lord Karasumaru, scattered across the regions.
m930022.問題は当代の帝がカラスマル卿ではなく、\nドウマンにゾッコンってところだろう。: The problem is that the current emperor is infatuated with Douman, not Lord Karasumaru.
m930022.彼女の手によって西の京──\nいや、東の国は混迷の中にいる。: By her hand, the western capital—no, the eastern lands are mired in chaos.
m930022.故に、我々はドウマンを討たねばならない。\nそれが戦乱を避けるための唯一の選択肢: So we have to defeat Douman. It's the only way to avert war.
m930022.東の都を中心としたシズカちゃん、\nヨシノちゃんたちが率いる武家勢力。: The samurai faction led by Shizuka-chan and Yoshino-chan, centered on the eastern capital.
m930022.現在、この国の勢力は大きく分けて三つ。: Currently, the nation's forces fall into three main factions.
m930022.神様だろうが、異国の王族だろうが関係ない。\n私の愛するこの国の平和のために働い: Whether you're a god or foreign royalty doesn't matter. I need you to work for the peace of this country I love.
m930022.私の名前はセイメイ、どこにでもいる浪人陰陽師だ。: I'm Seimei, just a wandering onmyoji you'll find everywhere.
m930022.簡潔に言うと、私はこの世の何処にもいなかった。: To put it bluntly, I wasn't anywhere in this world.
m930022.純粋な戦力だけを比べた場合は、\n妖怪総大将や王国と協力関係にある、\n東の都の: If you compare pure combat strength, the eastern capital's samurai—who cooperate with the Great General of Yokai and the kingdom—have overwhelming superiority.
m930022.覚悟はいいかな？ 駄目だと言っても連れて行くがね。: Are you prepared? Even if you say no, I'll take you with me.
m930022.陰陽寮の奴らは帝の権威を盾に、\n必ずヨシノちゃんを攻撃してくる。: The Onmyoji Academy uses the emperor's authority as a shield and will inevitably attack you, Yoshino-chan.
m930022.魔物との戦闘時に後ろから刺されてしまってね、\n気づいたときには鬼門の中に閉じ込: I was stabbed from behind in a battle with monsters, and when I came to I was trapped inside the Demon Gate.
m930022.（私より理不尽だな、この人）: (He's even more unreasonable than I am.)
